title: When the Static Turns
author: Mirabel Oyelaran
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
